How can I modify the workbook so that selecting just the month from the data validation list in A2 will also automatically update the monthly total in B5? I've created an Index match in B2 and C2 as well as a data validation list in A2. Now I want my 'overview' sheet to calculate the monthly total of all paychecks in B5 based on the month chosen in A2. wb = load_workbook(file_path)
ws_overview = wb['Overview']

# 1. Get the value from A2 in 'Overview' sheet
# A2 is row 2, col 1
selected_date_val = ws_overview['A2'].value

# The input data shows A2 contains '2016-01-29 00:00:00'
if selected_date_val is None:
    total_monthly = 0
else:
    # Ensure it's a datetime object
    if not hasattr(selected_date_val, 'month'):
        try:
            selected_date_val = pd.to_datetime(selected_date_val)
        except:
            total_monthly = 0
            selected_date_val = None
    
    if selected_date_val:
        target_month = selected_date_val.month
        target_year = selected_date_val.year
        
        # 2. Calculate the sum from 'Pay Dates' sheet
        # Data extent: rows 1-27, cols A-C. Row 1 is header.
        total_monthly = 0
        for row in ws_pay_dates.iter_rows(min_row=2, max_col=3, values_only=True):
            date_val, p1, p2 = row
            if date_val and hasattr(date_val, 'month'):
                if date_val.month == target_month and date_val.year == target_year:
                    # Sum Paycheck 1 and Paycheck 2
                    total_monthly += (p1 if p1 else 0) + (p2 if p2 else 0)
    else:
        total_monthly = 0

# 3. Write the literal value to B5 in 'Overview' sheet
# B5 is row 5, col 2
ws_overview['B5'] = total_monthly

# Save the workbook
output_path = '/mnt/data/outputs/8942_0_a7d2ab2c/1_8942_output.xlsx'
wb.save(output_path)",
